# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

Epilepsy Safe Mode
Epilepsy Safe Mode
Dampens color and removes blinks
This mode enables people with epilepsy to use the website safely by eliminating the risk of seizures
that result from flashing or blinking animations and risky color combinations.
Visually Impaired Mode
Visually Impaired Mode
Improves website's visuals
This mode adjusts the website for the convenience of users with visual impairments such as Degrading
Eyesight, Tunnel Vision, Cataract, Glaucoma, and others.
Cognitive Disability Mode
Cognitive Disability Mode
Helps to focus on specific content
This mode provides different assistive options to help users with cognitive impairments such as
Dyslexia, Autism, CVA, and others, to focus on the essential elements of the website more easily.
ADHD Friendly Mode
ADHD Friendly Mode
Reduces distractions and improve focus
This mode helps users with ADHD and Neurodevelopmental disorders to read, browse, and focus on the
main website elements more easily while significantly reducing distractions.
Blindness Mode
Blindness Mode
Allows using the site with your screen-reader
This mode configures the website to be compatible with screen-readers such as JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver,
and TalkBack. A screen-reader is software for blind users that is installed on a computer and
smartphone, and websites must be compatible with it.

NeilMed Pharmaceuticals Inc Accessibility Statement

## Accessibility Statement
* www.neilmed.com
* July 24, 2026

### Compliance status

We firmly believe that the internet should be available and accessible to anyone, and are committed
to providing a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of
circumstance and ability.

To fulfill this, we aim to adhere as strictly as possible to the World Wide Web Consortium’s (W3C)
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 (WCAG 2.1) at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to
make web content accessible to people with a wide array of disabilities. Complying with those
guidelines helps us ensure that the website is accessible to all people: blind people, people with
motor impairments, visual impairment, cognitive disabilities, and more.

This website utilizes various technologies that are meant to make it as accessible as possible at
all times. We utilize an accessibility interface that allows persons with specific disabilities to
adjust the website’s UI (user interface) and design it to their personal needs.

Additionally, the website utilizes an AI-based application that runs in the background and optimizes
its accessibility level constantly. This application remediates the website’s HTML, adapts Its
functionality and behavior for screen-readers used by the blind users, and for keyboard functions
used by individuals with motor impairments.

If you’ve found a malfunction or have ideas for improvement, we’ll be happy to hear from you. You
can reach out to the website’s operators by using the following email

### Screen-reader and keyboard navigation

Our website implements the ARIA attributes (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) technique,
alongside various different behavioral changes, to ensure blind users visiting with screen-readers
are able to read, comprehend, and enjoy the website’s functions. As soon as a user with a
screen-reader enters your site, they immediately receive a prompt to enter the Screen-Reader Profile
so they can browse and operate your site effectively. Here’s how our website covers some of the most
important screen-reader requirements, alongside console screenshots of code examples:
1. **Screen-reader optimization: **we run a background process that learns the website’s components
   from top to bottom, to ensure ongoing compliance even when updating the website. In this process,
   we provide screen-readers with meaningful data using the ARIA set of attributes. For example, we
   provide accurate form labels; descriptions for actionable icons (social media icons, search
   icons, cart icons, etc.); validation guidance for form inputs; element roles such as buttons,
   menus, modal dialogues (popups), and others. Additionally, the background process scans all of
   the website’s images and provides an accurate and meaningful image-object-recognition-based
   description as an ALT (alternate text) tag for images that are not described. It will also
   extract texts that are embedded within the image, using an OCR (optical character recognition)
   technology. To turn on screen-reader adjustments at any time, users need only to press the Alt+1
   keyboard combination. Screen-reader users also get automatic announcements to turn the
   Screen-reader mode on as soon as they enter the website.
   
   These adjustments are compatible with all popular screen readers, including JAWS and NVDA.
2. **Keyboard navigation optimization: **The background process also adjusts the website’s HTML, and
   adds various behaviors using JavaScript code to make the website operable by the keyboard. This
   includes the ability to navigate the website using the Tab and Shift+Tab keys, operate dropdowns
   with the arrow keys, close them with Esc, trigger buttons and links using the Enter key, navigate
   between radio and checkbox elements using the arrow keys, and fill them in with the Spacebar or
   Enter key.Additionally,

### Compliance status

We firmly believe that the internet should be available and accessible to anyone, and are committed
to providing a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of
circumstance and ability.

To fulfill this, we aim to adhere as strictly as possible to the World Wide Web Consortium’s (W3C)
Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 (WCAG 2.1) at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to
make web content accessible to people with a wide array of disabilities. Complying with those
guidelines helps us ensure that the website is accessible to all people: blind people, people with
motor impairments, visual impairment, cognitive disabilities, and more.

This website utilizes various technologies that are meant to make it as accessible as possible at
all times. We utilize an accessibility interface that allows persons with specific disabilities to
adjust the website’s UI (user interface) and design it to their personal needs.

Additionally, the website utilizes an AI-based application that runs in the background and optimizes
its accessibility level constantly. This application remediates the website’s HTML, adapts Its
functionality and behavior for screen-readers used by the blind users, and for keyboard functions
used by individuals with motor impairments.

If you’ve found a malfunction or have ideas for improvement, we’ll be happy to hear from you. You
can reach out to the website’s operators by using the following email

### Screen-reader and keyboard navigation

Our website implements the ARIA attributes (Accessible Rich Internet Applications) technique,
alongside various different behavioral changes, to ensure blind users visiting with screen-readers
are able to read, comprehend, and enjoy the website’s functions. As soon as a user with a
screen-reader enters your site, they immediately receive a prompt to enter the Screen-Reader Profile
so they can browse and operate your site effectively. Here’s how our website covers some of the most
important screen-reader requirements, alongside console screenshots of code examples:
1. **Screen-reader optimization: **we run a background process that learns the website’s components
   from top to bottom, to ensure ongoing compliance even when updating the website. In this process,
   we provide screen-readers with meaningful data using the ARIA set of attributes. For example, we
   provide accurate form labels; descriptions for actionable icons (social media icons, search
   icons, cart icons, etc.); validation guidance for form inputs; element roles such as buttons,
   menus, modal dialogues (popups), and others. Additionally, the background process scans all of
   the website’s images and provides an accurate and meaningful image-object-recognition-based
   description as an ALT (alternate text) tag for images that are not described. It will also
   extract texts that are embedded within the image, using an OCR (optical character recognition)
   technology. To turn on screen-reader adjustments at any time, users need only to press the Alt+1
   keyboard combination. Screen-reader users also get automatic announcements to turn the
   Screen-reader mode on as soon as they enter the website.
   
   These adjustments are compatible with all popular screen readers, including JAWS and NVDA.
2. **Keyboard navigation optimization: **The background process also adjusts the website’s HTML, and
   adds various behaviors using JavaScript code to make the website operable by the keyboard. This
   includes the ability to navigate the website using the Tab and Shift+Tab keys, operate dropdowns
   with the arrow keys, close them with Esc, trigger buttons and links using the Enter key, navigate
   between radio and checkbox elements using the arrow keys, and fill them in with the Spacebar or
   Enter key.Additionally,

Saline nasal wash is cleaning the nasal passages. Nasal wash cleans the mucosa lining the nose and
sinuses from infectious agents, allergens and irritants therefore play an important role in the
prevention and remedying of nasal allergy and sinus disorders.

[Learn More][22]

## Right Choice for Your Baby

Nasal hygiene is important for babies because;
Clean and open nose facilitates breastfeeding, nutrition and provides regular sleep.


They sleep regularly, grow healthy

Nasal cavities of babies are narrow and easier to get blocked. In addition they can't blow their
noses. Therefore, in keeping their noses clean and open, daily nasal cleansing is extremely
important.

[Learn More][23]

## FAQs

## What is Nasal Wash? Frequently Asked Questions

What is the advantage of saline nasal wash?

A fair amount of nasal mucus production is normal in the nose. Allergies and infections will lead to
too much mucus production. This will result in nasal symptoms such as runny nose and nasal
congestion. By nasal wash you can remove allergy-causing pollen, dust particles from nasal mucosa
and thus can reduce the inflammation of the mucus membranes. Normal mucosa is more resistant to
infection and allergy symptoms subside.

Nasal wash can be done at any time of the day. However, if applied at night, solution might drip
from the nostrils so applying one or two hours before bedtime is recommended. The same situation is
true before 1-2 hours leaving the house

What is a good time for saline nasal wash?

## FAQs

## What is Nasal Wash? Frequently Asked Questions

What is the advantage of saline nasal wash?

A fair amount of nasal mucus production is normal in the nose. Allergies and infections will lead to
too much mucus production. This will result in nasal symptoms such as runny nose and nasal
congestion. By nasal wash you can remove allergy-causing pollen, dust particles from nasal mucosa
and thus can reduce the inflammation of the mucus membranes. Normal mucosa is more resistant to
infection and allergy symptoms subside.

Nasal wash can be done at any time of the day. However, if applied at night, solution might drip
from the nostrils so applying one or two hours before bedtime is recommended. The same situation is
true before 1-2 hours leaving the house

Here at BreathMD.com we are dedicated to helping you know what you need to do to have the best
breath possible so you can live your life fully with confidence.

# The online guide to fresh breath

       We are dedicated to providing you with quality information on how to get rid of bad breath
with proper oral health care procedures and effective products. You will find excellent information
here that will make your breath fresh and stay fresh longer than you thought possible. We invite you
to read our articles to find the best oral care products and procedures. To get started read our
main articles on [What Causes Bad Breath][7] and [How To Get Rid of Bad Breath][8].

## [Oral Care Articles][9]

Read articles on what causes bad breath and what you need to do to make sure you have fresh breath.
Topics range from how to get rid of morning breath to what ingredients to look for or avoid in
buying toothpaste.

## [Oral Health News][10]

The latest science and news on bad breath, oral hygiene, and dental health. We add fresh posts as
new research comes out, so you can keep up with what's actually new in oral care.

## [Site Map][11]

The site map of the website. Contains an outline of BreathMD to help you navigate through it and
find a specific section or page.

## [Contact][12]

Lists the contact information for BreathMD and has an online form to allow you to send messages to
us. If you encounter any problems or have any questions, don't hesitate to ask.

All rights reserved.

[Dysphagia][35] means that you cannot swallow well. If you have concerns about your ability to
swallow, [take this 10-question quiz][36]. Summer is also when many families want to get outside and
enjoy the warm weather but make sure to [protect your loved ones against skin cancer][37]. And find
out what you should know about [congenital cytomegalovirus (cCMV)][38].

[**Visit Be ENT Smart for more health tips.**][39]

[Sign In][6]Book a Demo

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]
  Mitch EgerProduct Marketing Manager, Polygon Labs
* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and
  it's directly shaped how our Brand team positioned our next campaign."
  
  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

Sources

## Beyond the usual sources

We monitor the hidden sources everyone misses plus integrate custom sources specific to your
industry.

## A Leading International Pharmaceutical Company located in Greece

The story of the Gerolymatos International **Pharma** began almost 100 years ago in 1923, when
pharmacist, Nikos Gerolymatos, opened his own pharmacy in the heart of Athens. The pharmacy became
one of the largest in the country and the small family business grew. Guided by the dedication of
its founder, the entrepreneurial spirit of his son, Panagiotis, and now his grandson, Nicholas,
Gerolymatos International, is today, one of the most historical, traditional and well-regarded
family businesses in the Greek healthcare industry.

Based in Athens, Greece, with affiliated companies in France, Italy and Cyprus, Gerolymatos
International has a significant **global presence in over 50 countries **worldwide through exclusive
distribution partnerships for its own brand portfolio, namely, **Sinomarin®** (natural nasal & ear
care sea water sprays & vials -medical devices) & **Tamarine®** (pharmaceutical natural laxative in
marmalade form).

With a fully-owned pumping and processing installation for sea water in the northern French Britany
coast –the cleanest, most pristine waters- and a dedicated manufacturing facility in Athens, Greece,
Gerolymatos International produces its Sinomarin product lines for 40 international markets. The
company also provides **contract manufacturing** for hypertonic and isotonic **seawater-based nasal
sprays** and has become a leading **sea water nasal spray manufacturer**, delivering highest quality
products on private label.

Gerolymatos International is committed to pharmaceutical manufacturing, research & development,
marketing, distribution and sales of its own of its own product lines as well as the exclusive
distribution of products from highly esteemed international partners.

With an enduring presence in the Greek domestic market, the company operates in three distinct
segments:
* **OTC division**: caters to the Pharmacy and Supermarket channels, marketing the Company’s own
  brands, and exclusively distributes a wide range of imported OTC products such as **Biofreeze**
  external pain relief portfolio and **Hipp** **organic baby milks and foods**,
* **Optics division**: exclusively distributes the **Alcon Vision Care** product portfolio including
  contact lenses, solutions and eye drops,
* **Vet division**: exclusively distributes the veterinary pharmaceutical product portfolio of
  **Boehringer Ingelheim** and **Affinity Petcare’s** clinical nutrition portfolio.

The company’s extended business network in Greece and abroad includes Pharmaceutical companies and
healthcare professionals such as medical doctors, veterinarians, opticians and pharmacists, amongst
other specialties.

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

The pharmaceutical industry is undergoing a remarkable digital transformation, supported by concrete
market research and verified statistics. The scale of this transformation is evidenced by the
pharmaceutical digital platform market’s projected growth from $4.92 billion in 2023 to $34.12
billion by 2032, representing a robust CAGR of 24.35%. This growth is driven by widespread cloud
adoption, with approximately 80% of pharmaceutical companies already utilizing cloud computing
solutions and 95% expected to be fully cloud-operational within two years.

The transformation is happening across multiple dimensions, with web-based solutions dominating at
72.27% market share and AI-driven engagement representing 27.05% of patient engagement solutions.
Quality management systems are also evolving, with the market expected to grow from $1.87 billion in
2024 to $3.85 billion by 2030 at a CAGR of 12.99%. This digital evolution is particularly strong in
North America, which holds a 43.6% share in patient engagement solutions and 39% of the quality
management software market. Implementation timelines vary by solution complexity, ranging from 3-6
months for modular SaaS deployments to 9-18 months for full-suite implementations, reflecting the
industry’s methodical approach to digital adoption while maintaining compliance with regulatory
requirements.

## Who can benefit from balloon sinuplasty?

Balloon sinuplasty is a pain-free procedure that provides lasting relief for those suffering from
several chronic sinus issues. Balloon sinuplasty is simple and performed 100% in-office by Dr.
Michael Kaplan, who inserts and inflates a small balloon in your affected sinuses in order to
restore proper shape and airflow. Best of all, balloon sinuplasty is typically covered by most
insurance providers and Medicare.

Sinus snoring

[Chevron down]

### A snoring solution that works

Snoring is closely related to sinus health. Balloon sinuplasty stops snoring in its tracks by
opening blocked sinus cavities, allowing you to breathe easier through your nose during sleep.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Snoring][20]
[Woman laughing][Man smiling]

Frequent infections

[Chevron down]

### Finally, real freedom from chronic sinusitis

Chronic sinusitis balloon sinuplasty targets the source of chronic sinus infections by opening
blocked sinus cavities, providing you with long-term freedom from symptoms and future infections.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Chronic Sinusitis][21]
[Man cycling][Smiling woman]

Sinus headaches

[Chevron down]

### Eliminate chronic sinus headaches at the source

Balloon sinuplasty improves your sinus cavities’ ability to drain built-up mucus, reducing pressure
and relieving painful sinus headache symptoms.

[Woman waking up][Child smiling]

excess post nasal drip can drain properly and you can finally find relief from your chronic cough.

# Ear, Nose & Throat
# Specialists

Melbourne ENT Group (MEG) are a dynamic and innovative ENT specialist and sub-specialist practice
applying world’s best evidence and state-of-the-art techniques in the care of our patients.

[Our Services][21] [Contact Us][22]

## Operations & Procedures

###### ENT Surgeons applying world's best evidence and sub-specialty training to common and
###### advanced ear nose and throat procedures, both in the operating room, and the office

### Ear Procedures

Operations involving the ear can be classified into those affecting the inner, middle or external
ear, or a combination.

[Read More][24]

### Nose Procedures

Operations involving the nose can be divided into those affecting the external nose, the nasal
cavity and the sinuses.
[Read More][25]

### Throat Procedures

Operations involving the throat can be classified into those affecting the inner, middle or external
ear, or a combination.

### Office Procedures

Office based procedures are minor diagnostic or treatment procedures that our team performs in our
various consulting clinics

Melbourne ENT is the ENT practice of Dr Stephen Kleid and Dr Simon Braham. Both FRACS surgeons
deliver thorough, clear, and compassionate care tailored to each patient.

**Dr Stephen Kleid **has over 35 years’ surgical experience in nose surgery and common ENT problems
like snoring and sleep apnoea. He also has senior roles at Peter MacCallum Cancer Centre for head
and neck tumours.

**Dr Simon Braham**, trained in New York and Boston, performs surgery for nasal and sinus
conditions.

Dr Stephen Kleid

Dr Stephen Kleid MBBS FRACS is a highly experienced Ear, Nose and Throat ENT Surgeon
(Otolaryngologist) based in Melbourne, with a passion for Nose Surgery – Septo-Rhinoplasty,
Septoplasty and a strong interest in Rhinoplasty Revision. He also performs a wide range of ENT
surgery problems such as Tonsils, Adenoids and Grommets.

Dr Kleid has performed over 10,000 nose and sinus operations including 2000 rhinoplasties in over 35
years of Surgery. He is one of Australia's most experienced Head and Neck Surgeons and teaches his
innovative surgical techniques.

**AHPRA** (Medical Board) Registration number – MED0001052799
**MBBS FRACS** (Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons)

**AAFPRS** – (International Member of the American Academy of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive
Surgeons)

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

[injection_icon (4)]

Easy to use. No nasal swabs or needles

[shield_icon (2)]

Safe to use, even if opioids are not present

[prescription_icon]

Original prescription strength

[clock_icon]

Works quickly, often reversing an opioid overdose in minutes

[ambulance_icon]

Same brand used by first responders

[Hand Spraying Narcan Nasal Spray]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

# NARCAN^{®} NASAL SPRAY – ANYONE CAN SAVE A LIFE

Be ready – at home or on the go. NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray is a treatment designed to rapidly reverse
the effects of a life-threatening opioid emergency. Available as an over-the-counter medicine.

## BE PREPARED
## WITH NARCAN® NASAL SPRAY

Naloxone, the active ingredient in NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray, competes with opioids to bind with the
same receptors in the brain, reversing the effects of an opioid overdose in 2 to 3 minutes.

Carrying NARCAN^{®} Nasal Spray can make all the difference in an opioid emergency.

[injection_icon (4)]

Easy to use. No nasal swabs or needles

[shield_icon (2)]

Safe to use, even if opioids are not present

[prescription_icon]

Original prescription strength

[clock_icon]

Works quickly, often reversing an opioid overdose in minutes

[ambulance_icon]

Same brand used by first responders

[Hand Spraying Narcan Nasal Spray]

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

## How to Administer NARCAN^{® }Nasal Spray

Remember these important actions in case of a suspected opioid emergency.

[Narcan Usage Steps - Step One Lay]
**LAY**
* **Check for slowed breathing or unresponsiveness.**
* Lay the person on their back and tilt the head up.
**SPRAY**
* **Insert device into either nostril** and press plunger firmly.
**STAY**
* **Call 911 immediately** after giving the first dose. Continue to administer doses every 2-3
  minutes and wait with the person until help arrives. Use as directed. 1 nasal spray device
  contains 1 dose. Safe to keep giving doses as needed.

NeilMed Pharmaceuticals was founded by Dr. Mehta and his wife Nina in Santa Rosa, California, with a
mission to make safe and effective nasal and sinus care accessible to everyone.

What started as a simple physician’s idea has become a globally trusted brand, recommended by ENT
specialists and healthcare professionals in over 70 countries for over two decades.

## Our Core Values

### Clinically Proven Care

comfort and effectiveness.

BPA, and latex.

### Global Wellness

With millions of users worldwide, NeilMed continues to promote better breathing and wellness across
all ages and lifestyles.

2000

#### The Beginning

with chronic sinus issues.

2010

#### Global Trust

NeilMed became one of the most recommended brands for nasal irrigation worldwide, distributed across
hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics.

2025

#### Innovation for Every Breath

packaging for future generations.

## Classic Collections

### NeilMed Sinus Rinse™

The best-selling nasal irrigation system trusted by doctors worldwide. It provides natural relief
for congestion, allergies, and sinus symptoms with gentle saline rinsing.

### NeilMed NasaFlo® Neti Pot

Inspired by Ayurveda, this portable ceramic-style system delivers a smooth, soothing rinse
experience to flush out mucus and allergens naturally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

01

### Are NeilMed products safe for everyday use?

Yes. NeilMed products are formulated for gentle daily use and are recommended by physicians
worldwide for safe nasal hygiene.

02

### How do I prepare the saline solution?

Use NeilMed pre-mixed packets with previously boiled or distilled water. Always follow the
instructions included in each box for proper hygiene.

03

### Can children use NeilMed Sinus Rinse?

Children aged 4 and above can use NeilMed products under adult supervision. Pediatric versions are
available for more comfortable use.

04

### What if I experience discomfort during use?

Ensure the solution is the correct concentration and at body temperature. If irritation persists,
consult your healthcare provider before continuing use.

## Our Story

From a medical idea to a global movement in nasal care.

NeilMed Pharmaceuticals was founded by Dr. Mehta and his wife Nina in Santa Rosa, California, with a
mission to make safe and effective nasal and sinus care accessible to everyone.

What started as a simple physician’s idea has become a globally trusted brand, recommended by ENT
specialists and healthcare professionals in over 70 countries for over two decades.

## Our Core Values

Dedicated to health, innovation, and safety you can trust.

### Clinically Proven Care

All NeilMed products are designed with medical expertise and backed by scientific research to ensure
comfort and effectiveness.

### Safe & Sterile

We maintain the highest manufacturing standards, ensuring every product is free from preservatives,
BPA, and latex.

### Global Wellness

With millions of users worldwide, NeilMed continues to promote better breathing and wellness across
all ages and lifestyles.

## Our Journey

From California to the world.

2000

#### The Beginning

Dr. Mehta created the first NeilMed Sinus Rinse bottle system after witnessing patients’ struggles
with chronic sinus issues.

2010

#### Global Trust

NeilMed became one of the most recommended brands for nasal irrigation worldwide, distributed across
hospitals, pharmacies, and clinics.

2025

#### Innovation for Every Breath

NeilMed continues to expand its product range, integrating user-focused technology and sustainable
packaging for future generations.

## Classic Collections

### NeilMed Sinus Rinse™

The best-selling nasal irrigation system trusted by doctors worldwide. It provides natural relief
for congestion, allergies, and sinus symptoms with gentle saline rinsing.

### NeilMed NasaFlo® Neti Pot

Inspired by Ayurveda, this portable ceramic-style system delivers a smooth, soothing rinse
experience to flush out mucus and allergens naturally.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common concerns about sinus health and NeilMed products.

01

### Are NeilMed products safe for everyday use?

Yes. NeilMed products are formulated for gentle daily use and are recommended by physicians
worldwide for safe nasal hygiene.

02

### How do I prepare the saline solution?

Use NeilMed pre-mixed packets with previously boiled or distilled water. Always follow the
instructions included in each box for proper hygiene.

03

### Can children use NeilMed Sinus Rinse?

Children aged 4 and above can use NeilMed products under adult supervision. Pediatric versions are
available for more comfortable use.

04

### What if I experience discomfort during use?

Ensure the solution is the correct concentration and at body temperature. If irritation persists,
consult your healthcare provider before continuing use.

You. **When was the last time you saw an ad for apples or a billboard for broccoli?** The system is set up to promote pills, not produce. **NutritionFacts.org is a science-based nonprofit charity** committed to bringing the medical literature to you, breaking down the latest in evidence-based nutrition research, and presenting the results in ways that are easy to understand. We regularly share videos, blogs, webinars, live Q&As, guides, infographics, and more—without commercial bias, sponsors, or ads, so every one of us can make the best dietary and lifestyle choices. [About Us][56] [Videos][57] [Resources][58] ## Our Values ### Evidence-Based Every day, about 5,000 scientific papers are published in peer-reviewed medical journals, and groundbreaking nutrition research too often gets lost and buried. We comb through the literature and share practical tips to improve your life. ### Accessible Science is universal, so we are committed to presenting the latest in nutrition and health research in ways that are easy to understand no matter your background or training, in many different languages, and at no cost to you. ### Accountable Corrupting commercial and ideological interests have led to a stew of nutritional misinformation. Don't take anyone's word on something as life-and-death important as what to eat and feed your family. Our videos cite the science and also show the actual studies and link to all the original sources. ### Non-Commercial As a nonprofit organization, we offer a strictly non-commercial public service. We do not accept advertisements, corporate sponsorships, brand partnerships, or paid subscriptions, and all funds received from speaking engagements and book sales are donated directly to charity. Even the progression of some of our leading killers—heart disease, type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure, and kidney failure may be *reversed* with a healthy enough diet and lifestyle. # Breathing innovation into nasal drug delivery

The nose offers great potential as a patient-friendly pathway for local and systemic drug delivery.
Our expertise and technical capabilities in the development and manufacturing of nasal drug products
are designed to ensure that potential is realised for pharma partners.

## Key services for pharmaceutical partners
* **Nasal spray manufacturing capabilities**
  
  Our broad expertise in nasal drug delivery spans the entire product development cycle from
  formulation science to scale-up manufacture. Whether working with unit-dose, bi-dose or multi-dose
  products (preserved and sterile/non-preserved), the capabilities offered by our skilled in-house
  scientists and engineers ensures we can support any nasal project at any stage.
* **Nasal spray testing**
  
  Equipped with a state-of-the-art laboratory, we have the capabilities to conduct a wide range of
  nasal spray testing services across unit-dose, bi-dose and multi-dose devices, covering everything
  from particle-size distribution to plume geometry. The combination of detailed spray
  characterisation and decades of experience enable us to enhance and accelerate product
  development.
* **Nasal spray development**
  
  We are a specialist CDMO for nasal drug products, and our experience in the sector runs deep
  throughout the organisation. That means our partners can lean on our authoritative knowledge to
  guide and advance projects at any stage, from initial concept and testing through to device
  selection and commercialisation.
* **Site transfer**
  
  Balancing rigorous structure with the ability to flex manufacturing capacity, we can support the
  seamless transfer of intranasal products currently in commercial production. The process is
  closely monitored and managed by our experienced project managers, who are assigned to ensure
  project deadlines are met and transition to the facility is completed smoothly.

# SGD Pharma is a global leader in glass pharmaceutical packaging

SGD Pharma produces over 8 million vials and bottles per day at its 10 manufacturing plants in
Europe and Asia. All plants are ISO 15378 certified.

With 9 sales offices and a wide distribution network, SGD Pharma offers a broad range of sizes and
finishes in Type I, II, or III, amber and clear glass, as well as innovative added-value services
like internal and external treatments or protective plastic coatings.

# Welcome to SoHum Health

Southern Humboldt Community Healthcare District (SHCHD) operates Jerold Phelps Community
[Hospital][52], Southern Humboldt Community [Clinic][53], Southern Humboldt [Family Resource
Center][54], Garberville [Pharmacy][55], and Fortuna [Optometry][56]. We offer laboratory,
radiology, physical therapy, a 24-hour emergency room, inpatient care, skilled nursing, primary
care, home health, pharmacy, and optometry services.

## Emergency 24/7

The emergency room at Jerold Phelps Community Hospital is the only ER in Southern Humboldt county,
and it’s open 24/7.

][59]
[

## Walk-In Lab Services

We are the only medical lab in Humboldt County that’s open seven days a week, 8 am to 5 pm. We offer
a wide range of lab services with no appointments needed for testing.

][60]
[

## Imaging

Imaging services are available 24/7 through the Emergency department as well as on an outpatient
basis during business hours.

][61]

## Clinic

Southern Humboldt Community Clinic is a full-service rural clinic open weekdays 8:30-5:00, and also
offers a visiting nurse program.

][62]

## Garberville Pharmacy

Garberville Pharmacy is open Monday-Friday 9:30am-6:00pm for same-day prescriptions and
over-the-counter medication purchases. Located at 286 Sprowel Creek Road in Garberville.

][63]

## Family Resource Center

The Southern Humboldt Family Resource Center is a place where all Southern Humboldt children, their
families, and community members can get information and help.

][64]

# Welcome to SoHum Health

Southern Humboldt Community Healthcare District (SHCHD) operates Jerold Phelps Community
[Hospital][52], Southern Humboldt Community [Clinic][53], Southern Humboldt [Family Resource
Center][54], Garberville [Pharmacy][55], and Fortuna [Optometry][56]. We offer laboratory,
radiology, physical therapy, a 24-hour emergency room, inpatient care, skilled nursing, primary
care, home health, pharmacy, and optometry services.

[Board Meeting Agendas][57]   [Recent Agenda][58]


 

[

## Emergency 24/7

The emergency room at Jerold Phelps Community Hospital is the only ER in Southern Humboldt county,
and it’s open 24/7.

][59]
[

## Walk-In Lab Services

We are the only medical lab in Humboldt County that’s open seven days a week, 8 am to 5 pm. We offer
a wide range of lab services with no appointments needed for testing.

][60]
[

## Imaging

Imaging services are available 24/7 through the Emergency department as well as on an outpatient
basis during business hours.

][61]
[

## Clinic

Southern Humboldt Community Clinic is a full-service rural clinic open weekdays 8:30-5:00, and also
offers a visiting nurse program.

][62]
[

## Garberville Pharmacy

Garberville Pharmacy is open Monday-Friday 9:30am-6:00pm for same-day prescriptions and
over-the-counter medication purchases. Located at 286 Sprowel Creek Road in Garberville.

][63]
[

## Family Resource Center

The Southern Humboldt Family Resource Center is a place where all Southern Humboldt children, their
families, and community members can get information and help.

][64]
[

SoHum Health is moving forward with the construction of a new hospital and clinic to serve
Garberville and the surrounding communities. The new facility, to be located at 286 Sprowel…

][65]
[

## Garberville Optometry

Garberville Optometry is now serving Southern Humboldt on our mobile optometry unit! We accept most
major insurance types, including Medicare and Partnership VSP, as well as private pay. Home Base…

][66]

that a broadly diverse array of microbes inhabiting your gut leads not only to improved digestion
but also to reduced chronic inflammation and resistance to disease.

Booth: Q18
Syntron Electromechanical Feeders
Syntron Material Handling
Syntron® MF heavy-duty electromechanical feeders are the heavyweights of bulk material handling,
used for higher-capacity requirements. The eight heavy-duty models handle capacities from 100 to
4,000 tons per hour.*

Syntron heavy-duty electromechanical feeders combine extra structural strength with durable
components. The deep wing plates form a bridge between the inlet and discharge suspension supports,
providing extra strength for years of dependable service. Standard troughs feature unitized
weldments—one-piece, completely welded units for greater strength. Troughs are also available with
bolt-together construction for tunnel installations or other confined areas. MF heavy-duty
electromechanical feeders are two-mass, spring-connected, and sub-resonant-tuned. The exciter unit
is connected to the trough via corrosion-resistant polymeric drive springs, which reduce vertical
stroke while amplifying stroke in the direction of material flow. This feature creates straight line
motion, providing maximum material flow rate and feeder capacity. Syntron feeders also utilize
custom-engineered electromechanical vibrators. These vibrators feature an L10 life expectancy of
over 100,000 hours in normal operation, and they allow quick removal via access from both sides of
the feeder or from the bottom. Attachments for safety cables are included on all Syntron feeders.

*Based on dry sand weighing 100 pounds per cubic foot. Capacities vary depending on material
characteristics, material density, trough length and width, trough liner type, feeder installation,
skirt boards, and hopper transitions.
][37] [
Exposibram 2026
Booth: Q18
Syntron SyntroFlo Cone Crusher Feeder
Syntron Material Handling
The SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder by Syntron is a MF two-mass tuned direct drive vibratory
feeder with an engineered discharge uniquely designed for equal distribution of product. The trough
including the discharge is fully lined to account for wear. Like traditionally designed feeders, it
is suspension mounted, which can be easily integrated into a trolley system allowing it to be moved
out of the way for crusher maintenance. In side-by-side installations of a feeder-plus-rotary
distributor versus a SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder directly feeding the crusher, the
SyntroFlo unit delivered superior, cone-friendly performance. The uniform distribution provided by
the SyntroFlo unit increased curser manganese life and yielded more cubicle-formed product.

SyntroFlo is available in three standard sizes for tertiary crusher applications: STF-3F, STF-4F,
and STF-5F. In addition, we are developing the STF-3C, STF-4C, and STF-5C for secondary crushing
applications. Both designs work with 300 HP, 400 HP, and 500 HP cones, respectively. These designs
will allow the SyntroFlo unit to be a cost-effective solution for feeding your cone crusher
equipment. We can build a custom cone crushing feeder unit for larger and smaller applications upon
request.

Syntron Electromechanical Feeders
Syntron Material Handling
Syntron® MF heavy-duty electromechanical feeders are the heavyweights of bulk material handling,
used for higher-capacity requirements. The eight heavy-duty models handle capacities from 100 to
4,000 tons per hour.*

Syntron heavy-duty electromechanical feeders combine extra structural strength with durable
components. The deep wing plates form a bridge between the inlet and discharge suspension supports,
providing extra strength for years of dependable service. Standard troughs feature unitized
weldments—one-piece, completely welded units for greater strength. Troughs are also available with
bolt-together construction for tunnel installations or other confined areas. MF heavy-duty
electromechanical feeders are two-mass, spring-connected, and sub-resonant-tuned. The exciter unit
is connected to the trough via corrosion-resistant polymeric drive springs, which reduce vertical
stroke while amplifying stroke in the direction of material flow. This feature creates straight line
motion, providing maximum material flow rate and feeder capacity. Syntron feeders also utilize
custom-engineered electromechanical vibrators. These vibrators feature an L10 life expectancy of
over 100,000 hours in normal operation, and they allow quick removal via access from both sides of
the feeder or from the bottom. Attachments for safety cables are included on all Syntron feeders.

*Based on dry sand weighing 100 pounds per cubic foot. Capacities vary depending on material
characteristics, material density, trough length and width, trough liner type, feeder installation,
skirt boards, and hopper transitions.
][37] [
Exposibram 2026

Syntron SyntroFlo Cone Crusher Feeder
Syntron Material Handling
The SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder by Syntron is a MF two-mass tuned direct drive vibratory
feeder with an engineered discharge uniquely designed for equal distribution of product. The trough
including the discharge is fully lined to account for wear. Like traditionally designed feeders, it
is suspension mounted, which can be easily integrated into a trolley system allowing it to be moved
out of the way for crusher maintenance. In side-by-side installations of a feeder-plus-rotary
distributor versus a SyntroFlo cone crusher loading feeder directly feeding the crusher, the
SyntroFlo unit delivered superior, cone-friendly performance. The uniform distribution provided by
the SyntroFlo unit increased curser manganese life and yielded more cubicle-formed product.

SyntroFlo is available in three standard sizes for tertiary crusher applications: STF-3F, STF-4F,
and STF-5F. In addition, we are developing the STF-3C, STF-4C, and STF-5C for secondary crushing
applications. Both designs work with 300 HP, 400 HP, and 500 HP cones, respectively. These designs
will allow the SyntroFlo unit to be a cost-effective solution for feeding your cone crusher
equipment. We can build a custom cone crushing feeder unit for larger and smaller applications upon
request.

world's elite doctors to collaborate on pioneering medical advancements tailored for you.

At Tarabichi ENT, we pride ourselves on our team of highly experienced and renowned doctors, each a
leader in their respective sub-specialty within the field of ENT. Our doctors are carefully selected
based on their exceptional expertise, extensive experience, and their unwavering commitment to

## ANNUAL CONFERENCE


The Annual Meeting of the Middle East Academy of Otolaryngology and Head & Neck Surgery (ME-AOHNS)
is one of the largest ENT gatherings in the Middle East. The congress brings together leading ENT
doctors, specialists, surgeons, and speakers from across the region and internationally. 

The scientific programme covers major ENT subspecialties, including Rhinology and Endoscopic Skull
Base Surgery, Otology and Cochlear Implantation, Pediatric Otolaryngology, Facial Plastic Surgery,
Sleep Surgery, Head and Neck Surgery, and Audio-Vestibular Medicine. The programme also features
interactive panel discussions and practical insights into real clinical cases.

Lauren Natbony is a headache doctor and mom who also lives with migraine. Watch her video to learn
how she uses Trudhesa to treat her own migraine attacks and what advice she gives to her patients
and anyone with migraine.

[View Transcript Close Transcript][18]

You don’t have to stop living your life, because you’re in the midst of a migraine attack, because
Trudhesa will still be there waiting for you and it will still work.

**TITLE:** Migraine Moments
Dr Natbony talks treating with Trudhesa

**Intro**
I’m doctor Lauren Natbony. I am a headache specialist, and I’m the founder and Medical Director of
Integrative Headache Medicine of New York in New York City.

**Tell us about a time you treated a migraine with Trudhesa**

coasters. So I went with them, on a really twisty, windy roller coaster, and I immediately felt
nauseous right, coming off I’m like oh I think I might just throw up, and then I felt the migraine
starting. It’s like creeping in there. And I’m like OK, I’m going to be OK, right? Just going to
drink some water, have some caffeine, eat something, right? Because I’m probably just dehydrated. I
said that to myself, even though I know I’m a headache doctor, right. I know I should be taking
something. And then I realized I’m gonna miss out on this whole day with my family. I should just
take something.

So went into my bag, had some over-the-counter medications which I took and yeah, it kind of
dampened things maybe, maybe a little bit. I was able to get through a few more rides, not-not the
spinny ones, but some of the other ones.

But I knew that it just wasn’t enough. And there’s this show that night that I really want to see.
My kids have been waiting and waiting to see it, and I know I have Trudhesa. It’s there it’s in my
backpack.

I took it and it was late, it was late into the attack. I spent the whole day in the heat, the whole
day nauseous. But was I able to make it to that fireworks show? Yes. Was I able to spend that time
with my kids? Yes.

I’m able to be there and be present. And how many of us are so afraid of missing out on life, right?
Like so afraid that we’ll do anything, anything, to just be there with our family. That’s what
Trudhesa that day allowed me to do. It allows me to treat at any point during my attack, and still
be able to live my life, be there with my family, be there with my kids, and enjoy those little
moments.

**Why do you think POD® technology is better than an average nasal spray**

positions to try to get that nasal spray to go right into the perfect spot. When I use a nasal spray
I think, “do I need to sniff it?” “does it need to be directed in a certain way?” “is it going to

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

When you’re shopping for medical supplies, the last thing you want to do is navigate multiple
stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on
  Google**][99]. Discover more about our success on [**Bloomberg**][100] or [**Inc. 5000**][101],
  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.

## FAQ's

## I have shopped at NeilMed.com before but can’t login to my account.

If you created an account or placed an order on NeilMed.com prior to October 5, 2021 you will need
to re-register again. We apologize for the inconvenience. We have updated our website and system and
for security purposes a new password is required.

## I forgot my password. How can I update it?

Go to Your Account, click "Sign in with your NeilMed Account". Under Personal Information, click
"Forgot your Password?". Enter your email address and continue to follow the instructions on the
screen. At the end of the process, you will receive an email with a link to reset your password. If
you are still having trouble, please contact our Customer Service at [1 877 477 8633][35] or email
[questions@neilmed.com][36] and we will help you update your password.

## Where can I find a retailer in my area that sells NeilMed products?

NeilMed products are available nationwide at all leading drug and food stores. Please visit our
[Store Locator][37] to find the local stores near you.

## Are your entire products on your website?

Yes, everything NeilMed currently has available is available for purchase on our website. If there
is something you cannot find, please contact our Customer Service toll free at [1 877 477 8633][38]
or email [questions@neilmed.com][39].

## Promotion Codes

NeilMed promotion codes can be redeemed in the Promotion Code section on the final page in the
checkout process, on the "Review & Place Order" screen. The promotion code reduces your cart
subtotal only and does not apply toward Shipping & Handling. A promotion code cannot be applied to
previous purchases and are only valid for use one time per customer. You can receive notice of our
special promotions by registering your email address on our email sign up form located in the footer
of our website.

## Payment Options

NeilMed.com accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and
Amazon Pay. We also accept Debit cards with a Visa or MasterCard logo.

## Telephone Orders

For the most efficient service we suggest you place your order online. If you prefer placing your
order by phone, please call [1 877 477 8633][40].

## Can I save the items in my cart?

By creating an account you can save items to your personal shopping cart indefinitely. Login to your
account, place items in your cart, review your cart and then select "Save for Later". The next time
you return to NeilMed.com, login to your account and proceed to the shopping

## wikiHow is an award-winning website where trusted research and expert knowledge come together.

Since 2005, wikiHow has helped billions of people learn how to solve problems large and small. We
work with credentialed experts, trained researchers, and a devoted community to create the
internet's most reliable, comprehensive, and delightful how-to articles and guides. Today, as the
fastest-growing quiz destination online, we also offer millions of users a fun, interactive space to
dive into their passions and put their knowledge to the test.
